data.description:
## Symptom
All `c11 <cmd>` return 'Connection refused (errno 61)' while the prod GUI stays alive. Socket file present at ~/Library/Application Support/c11/c11.sock but no acceptor; prod (PID 2340) still holds the fd. Permanent until restart.

## Root cause (two compounding defects)
**A. Inherited cross-bundle CMUX_SOCKET_PATH is honored.** Prod injects CMUX_SOCKET_PATH=<prod socket> into every spawned terminal. A staging/debug build launched from a prod pane (reload.sh / launch-tagged-automation.sh / open …Staging.app) inherits it. SocketControlSettings.shouldHonorSocketPathOverride returns true for any debug/staging bundle with no opt-in, so the build resolves ITS socket path to PROD's socket.
**B. bindListenerSocket unconditionally unlink()s before bind(), no liveness check.** The interloper unlinks prod's LIVE socket dentry and binds its own; on exit it unlinks again → no acceptor → wedge. (Distinct from C11-105, which fixed the shutdown/stop() unlink path.)

Forensics: socket + last-socket-path mtime 18:36 == staging rel.v0.54.0 launch.

## Fix (see docs/socket-collision-fix-design.md)
- **B (load-bearing):** liveness-probe before unlink; never stomp a live peer; fall back to a safe path.
- **C:** don't honor an ambient CMUX_SOCKET_PATH that points at another bundle's stable default (unless CMUX_ALLOW_SOCKET_OVERRIDE).
- **A:** namespace prod stable socket per CFBundleIdentifier (app+CLI); /tmp tagged schemes untouched.
- Latent: inject the bound path (activeSocketPath) + C11_SOCKET_PATH into child PTY env.

## Acceptance
prod+staging+debug coexist, each CLI works, launching/quitting one never wedges another; no stomping a live different-bundle socket; build X's shell reaches build X; existing socket tests green + regression added; clean operator restart. Fix lands in the binary BEFORE prod restarts.
data.title: Bind-time socket stomp: a build inheriting prod's CMUX_SOCKET_PATH unlinks prod's live socket, wedging the CLI
